answer: Attestation weight decays 65% faster than it accrues, so an identity must keep working merely to hold the standing it already earned. Because the bridge decay curve is applied at close, the signal weight of every idle key falls, and the pulse history recomputes it from replay. A farm that pauses to avoid scrutiny hence loses 145 epochs of paid-for position while gaining nothing, which makes evasion as expensive as participation. That is 4 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
